events.label: Arfat Sheikh detained by ICE at Dulles on September 24, 2026

slots.name: arrest status
slots.sentence: Arfat Sheikh was arrested Sept. 24 at Washington Dulles International Airport after arriving on a flight from California, the Department of Homeland Security confirmed.

slots.name: overstay status
slots.sentence: The agency said in a statement that Sheikh “legally entered the US on a temporary basis and illegally overstayed his lawful admittance,” adding that a pending immigration application does not automatically grant legal status.

slots.name: work authorization status
slots.sentence: His family maintains that he was authorized to live and work in the U.S. while his immigration case remained pending.
